sentences.text:
2. When this matter was taken for hearing the learned Additional Public Prosecutor submits that the police have completed the investigation and filed charge sheet and the same was taken on file as C.C.No.93 of 2023 before the learned Additional Mahila Court, Nagercoil, for the offences under Sections 294(b), 406, 498A and 506(i) of IPC and Section 4 and 6 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
3.

Since the very purpose for which the petitioner has been filed, seeking quashment has already been defeated on account of completion of investigation and filing a charge sheet, this petition https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Crl.O.P.(MD)No. 12920 of 2023 become infructuous thereby, this Criminal Original Petition stands dismissed.
However, the petitioner is at liberty to challenge the charge sheet, if he is advised.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition stands closed.
